text: The initiative is characterized by its integration into China's Five-Year Plans, emphasizing a strategic shift from relief to prevention, and from single-hazard to multi-hazard management. It includes standardized disaster loss statistics, significantly improving post-disaster loss estimation speed and quality. International cooperation, such as the IRDR-UNESCO sub-forum, promotes multi-stakeholder collaboration on climate-related vulnerabilities, culture, and public health.

metadata.solution_name: Consolidation and Mainstreaming of Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) in China
